title: Public API: a stock adjustment on an untracked part's bin is applied, the same as the CSV import
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Public API access to sv10647api.qa.shopview.com (authenticated as the public API requires). Data: QAPL-U2 (untracked, 2 bins with quantities). Before the run note each QAPL-U2 bin and its quantity from the Inventory list. Product decision A (SV-10818 comment 79428): public API stock adjustments are applied to untracked parts, the same as the CSV import.
custom_steps:
1. Search QAPL-U2 on /parts/inventory.
  2. Send POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments setting QAPL-U2's first bin to a new quantity (noted quantity + 4), in the request shape the public API documents.
  3. Reload /parts/inventory and search QAPL-U2.
  4. Open QAPL-U2 (Edit Inventory Part).
  5. Cleanup: send the same adjustment with the noted original quantity and reload the list.
custom_expected:
1. Total Qty reads "Not Tracked"; both bin chips show the noted quantities.
  2. The call succeeds (2xx); it is not refused with "{part number} is not tracked." (option B was not built).
  3. The first bin chip shows the new quantity, the second bin is unchanged, and Total Qty still reads "Not Tracked" (the part stays untracked).
  4. The switch is off, Min and Max are hidden, and the first bin row shows the new quantity next to the unchanged second bin.
  5. The call succeeds and the first bin shows the noted original quantity again; the part is still "Not Tracked".
